title: Fix the Reused Loop Variable
description: The program should print a 3x3 grid of row/column pairs using nested loops.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 3 rows, each showing the column index 0, 1, 2.
actualProblem: Both loops declare a variable named i in the same scope, which is a compile error in Java ('variable i is already defined in the method'). Even conceptually, reusing the outer loop's variable name for the inner loop hides the outer counter entirely.
explanation: Nested loops need distinct variable names for each loop counter (conventionally i for the outer loop and j for the inner one), both to avoid a compile error and to keep each loop's counter independently trackable.
